title: On some concepts of convergence and their connections
summary: The notions of classical two-scale convergence and the periodic unfolding method, which both rely on an additional scale for the representation of periodic micro-oscillations, are in this paper traced back to the wider concept of general two-scale convergence. Moreover, a comparison is made between very weak two-scale convergence and periodic unfolding with respect to sequences bounded in Sobolev spaces, amplified by the scale of the micro-oscillations.
